source.note: Original Lightweight topic and copy (owner request 2026-10-19). Format follows the proven 'problem → map → numbered fixes → product' pattern from references/PATTERN.md. Visual templates are our own approved slides of LW-CAR-0001.

figures: Smooth plastic anatomy mannequins with featureless pelvis; plain opaque short sand shorts on full-body figures as allowed by task.

slides.prompt:
Create ONE new ORIGINAL Lightweight carousel slide for LW-CAR-0006 using the attached OWN APPROVED LW-CAR-0001 slide as its visual template. Output one clean portrait PNG, 1080x1350 px (4:5). Copy the template's composition, whitespace, type hierarchy/size, coral badge and underline geometry, fine anatomical linework, colors, arch and exact small black Lightweight wordmark at the SAME top-left position and size. Reuse the supplied wordmark; do not invent any logo or symbol. Only the content, muscles and exercises described below change. This is an original Lightweight topic; there is no competitor reference. No TikTok interface, extra caption, signatures or watermarks.

Series palette: background #F0F1EB; giant pale coral #FBE3DD rounded arch rises on right behind content; accent #F26445 for target muscle areas, specified accent words, number badges, underline and OR badge; dark text #2A2A2A; body text #6B6B6B; white #FFFFFF in badges. All typography RUBIK: heaviest for cover, bold titles, semibold sets/exercise labels, regular smaller body/why sentences. Preserve EXACT text below, including punctuation, capitalization, apostrophes, hyphens and em dashes; never rewrite. Keep labels fully visible with bottom margin.

Figures: neutral smooth molded PLASTIC EDUCATIONAL ANATOMY MANNEQUINS with featureless bald heads/faces and smooth featureless pelvises, no genital detail. Fine grey outlined anatomical muscle-relief shapes in warm sand #D9CBBE with darker sand shading and ivory #F5F0E5 skin/tendons, exactly the approved series illustration treatment. No green or sage. All FULL-BODY mannequins wear plain opaque short athletic shorts in sand #D9CBBE covering waist/pelvis/uppermost thighs, as permitted by task and the accepted LW-CAR-0002 slide 6; leave hamstrings below hems and calves visible. No highlighted muscles except the specific target areas named per illustration. Black/grey/white realistic equipment. No photo-real human skin or unrelated creative variation.

SLIDE 1 COVER. Template is LW-CAR-0001 slide 1. Preserve its strong centered stacked headline, huge heaviest Rubik, soft grey offset shadow and right arch. This cover has THREE lines filling top roughly 40%:
THE MUSCLES
YOU'RE
FORGETTING
First two lines dark #2A2A2A; FORGETTING coral #F26445. Uniformly scale to fit; no fourth line, no shortening, no condensed substitute font. Optional small same coral paint-splat accent beside last word. Below headline one FULL-BODY smooth plastic anatomical mannequin in a confident three-quarter REAR view, one arm slightly forward so forearm and flank are visible. Whole figure from head to both feet must fit, including calves, roughly y=520..1285, slim enough to retain source whitespace. It wears plain short sand shorts. Exactly FIVE target groups coral: rear shoulder deltoids, forearms, obliques at side of core, posterior-thigh hamstrings, calves. All other muscle groups sand/ivory; do not highlight traps or lats. Keep body as one consistent mannequin, no extra diagram, label or other words.
slides.export_method: Uniform scaling to fit 1080x1350 and centered canvas extent; no independent-axis stretching.

SLIDE 3 / BADGE 1. Title: Rear Delts. Sets: 2-3 Sets x 10-15 Reps.
WHY: Pressing trains the front of your shoulders. The back gets almost nothing.
Middle close-up: rear upper back from shoulders to mid-back, no head, exactly like LW-CAR-0001 slide 6; ONLY the two posterior deltoid shoulder caps coral, all traps/lats sand.
LEFT exercise: seated REVERSE PEC-DECK, rear view, seated mannequin with arms spread toward handles at shoulder height, tall black/grey machine column in front, back toward viewer. Label: Reverse Pec Dec.
RIGHT exercise: standing CABLE FACE PULL with rope at FACE height, elbows high out to sides, side/rear three-quarter view. Rope pulled toward face, cable runs horizontally to pulley in front. Label: Face Pull.
Bottom full-body figures in short sand shorts; preserve template OR badge and two exercise locations. A second attached template may show the correct rear-delt crop; use its upper diagram only, not its old text or bottom exercise arrangement.
